business_summary: Aberdeen Multi-Market Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by MFS Investment Management, Inc. The fund invests in the fixed income markets across the globe with greater emphasis on United States. It seeks to invest in fixed income securities issued by U.S. Government, foreign government, mortgage backed, and other asset-backed securities of U.S. and foreign issuers, corporate bonds of U.S. and foreign issuers, and debt instruments of issuers located in emerging market countries with an average duration of 5.1 years. The fund employs fundamental analysis with bottom-up stock picking approach while focusing on factors such as underlying credit quality, collateral characteristics, and indenture provisions, and the issuer's management ability, capital structure, leverage, and ability to meet its current obligations. It seeks to benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against a combination of the Citigroup World Government Bond Non-Dollar Hedged Index, JPMorgan Emerging Markets Bond Index Global, Lehman Brothers U.S. Credit Bond Index, Lehman Brothers U.S. Government/Mortgage Bond Index, and Lehman Brothers U.S. High-Yield Corporate Bond Index. Aberdeen Multi-Market Income Fund was formed on March 12, 1987 and is domiciled in the Unites States.
business_summary_ko: Aberdeen Multi-Market Income Fund는 MFS Investment Management, Inc.가 출시하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 채권 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 미국에 중점을 두고 전 세계 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 미국 정부, 외국 정부가 발행한 채권, 미국 및 외국 발행인의 모기지 담보 및 기타 자산 유동화 증권, 미국 및 외국 발행인의 회사채, 신흥 시장 국가에 위치한 발행인의 채무 증서에 평균 5.1년 동안 투자하려고 합니다. 이 펀드는 기본 신용도, 담보 특성, 계약 조항, 발행인의 경영 능력, 자본 구조, 레버리지, 현재 의무 이행 능력 등의 요소에 초점을 맞추면서 상향식 주식 선정 접근 방식의 기본적 분석을 사용합니다. Citigroup World Government Bond Non-Dollar Hedged Index, JPMorgan Emerging Markets Bond Index Global, Lehman Brothers U.S. Credit Bond Index, Lehman Brothers U.S. Government/Mortgage Bond Index, Lehman Brothers U.S. High-Yield Corporate Bond Index의 조합을 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹하려고 합니다.
